# Test assets

`tone.wav` is a two-second 440 Hz waveform generated by `scripts/make_assets.py`.
It tests audio handling and contains no speech. The icon is authored SVG geometry
in `llplayer/assets/icon.svg`, rendered by the same script. Both are covered by
the first-party license in the repository root.

The recording previously copied from the upstream repository has been removed.
For a live speech-recognition check, pass a recording you have the right to use:

```sh
uv run python scripts/verify_services.py --speech /path/to/your-recording.wav
```

No speech-recognition accuracy claim is made from the synthetic tone.
